description: Defines the CameraMetadata class, a wrapper around camera_metadata_t, providing methods for managing camera metadata entries, serialization, and interaction with Android camera system components.

classes.name: CameraMetadata
classes.description: A convenience wrapper around the C-based camera_metadata_t library, providing methods for managing camera metadata entries, serialization, and interaction with Android camera system components.
